protocol.advance_to_next_family_if: No further families in this revision; failure is preserved
protocol.calendar: Existing R04 q/boundary and all generic resources; both sensor samples at q+3; no environmental quality feedback in the first link screen
protocol.codec: One exact public raw bit duplicated unchanged at E+(-1,0,+1) and E+(-1,0,-1). Both material state1 SEM1 direction0. This is a fixed symmetric sensor, not two bank-specific action channels. No action label, private operand or future condition is injected.
protocol.early_stop: Before starting an opportunity require at least60s remaining; segmented owner run_until checks the frozen wall deadline; save actual partial future at any timeout without returning to an older snapshot.
protocol.first_link_success_requires: All twelve sensor inputs applied; all six fixed outputs valid; equal raw bits give the same output in both orders; opposite bits differ; both sources are RAW0 before every repeated input. This establishes a reusable prepared perceptual link only, not learning.
protocol.physical_hypothesis: The prior upper-only sensor cleared natively but suppressed its bit1 output. A symmetric lower sample may cancel the Z-gradient natively while retaining a lateral contribution; no existing guard is removed. The proposed gradient cancellation is a hypothesis, not an executed result.
protocol.preservation: Complete native parent and sources preserved in every AUX arm; no cleanup, clock reset, guard deletion, target teaching, MAIN or S mutation. Current P0 anatomy/codec remain prepared, not acquired.
protocol.reader: Exactly the existing R04 three physical gates/direction classes; no absence-to-QUERY mapping or result-dependent new gate
protocol.type: AUX physical mechanism only; not an independently paired operational-life import

scope: Prepared sensor usability only; no task/quality/strategy-learning claim and no MAIN continuation
stopped: Guard/query limit before another complete opportunity
